ns2:section.sectionText: Students must register for both the "AL1" Lecture and an "AQ" online discussion. The following information is provided in an effort to help you better plan your academic (course) schedule for the semester: The course content (lecture material) will be asynchronous, which means that there will be pre-recorded lecture materials and other resources available through Compass 2G that you can consume as your schedule permits. The testing will be synchronous, which means that you will get tested during some of your scheduled Lecture and Discussion Section times. Make absolutely sure that you do Not willingly/knowingly schedule conflicts in your schedule that would overlap with the days/times assigned to our course. For example, the four on-line, multiple-choice exams (45-minutes in duration each) and the on-line, multiple-choice Final Exam (45-minutes in duration) will be available only during the days/times that the university has assigned to our course. Since the exams are offered during the regularly scheduled, in-class days/times, there are No Conflict Exams. There are No Make-up Exams – Instead, you get to drop your lowest exam score. Here is a schedule of the planned exam days/times: Exam 1 - Exam 2 - Exam 3 - Exam 4 - Final Exam - day/time gets assigned (TBD) by the Registrar’s Office
